active-le-clavier-la-manette-le-pilotage: Turn on the keyboard / gamepad / low-level input, and add your connections (RCON game server, OBS, MQTT…). Every connector has its own switch.
ajouter-un-type-puis-entree-ex-gaming-do: add a type then Enter (e.g. gaming, home automation, asmr)…
ce-que-le-clavier-fait-quand-l-interacti: What the keyboard does when the interaction fires. “Capture” reads your REAL keyboard: press a key, it writes itself.
change-l-api-ciblee-te-deconnecte-reconn: Changes the target API. Signs you out (sign back in on the new environment).
configure-ce-que-la-manette-virtuelle-fa: Set what the virtual gamepad does when the interaction fires. “Capture” reads the real gamepad (or keyboard) plugged into this PC.
decris-ce-qui-change-dans-cette-version-: Describe what changes in this version (new gifts, fixes…). Shown in the store and in the history.
description-courte-a-quoi-sert-le-pack-e: Short description: what the pack is for, in one or two sentences. Details and requirements go in “Instructions” below.
en-cliquant-sur-j-accepte-tu-confirmes-a: By clicking “I agree”, you confirm you have read and accepted the terms.
en-lien-avec-ton-pack-ton-jeu: related to your pack / your game
etoiles-generees-par-ce-pack-les-etoiles: Stars generated by this pack (stars earned = your commission, cashable).
fermer-la-fenetre-reduit-l-app-dans-la-z: Closing the window minimizes the app to the notification area (it keeps running). “Quit” from the tray icon really stops it.
format-schema-2-rules-evenements-gift-gi: Format: { "schema": 2, "rules": [ … ] }. Events: gift(giftSlug: any gift, e.g. "licorne", or a slot ix_slot_01..30), follow, comment(contains OR every), hearts(milestone OR every), share(every optional), viewer(every). “every” = every N (e.g. every 100 likes/messages/shares/viewers). Effects: keyboard(keys, backend), gamepad(button/buttons/sequence/randomFrom/steps/analog), rcon(command), obs(request), http(method,url), mqtt(topic,payload), osc(address,args), ws(url,message).
injection-clavier-normal-convient-a-la-p: Keyboard injection: “normal” works for most games; “low level” for the ones that ignore synthetic input.
lancer-hou-la-connect-au-demarrage-en-ar: Launch Hou.la Connect at startup (in the background)
marques-logos-que-tu-n-as-pas-le-droit-d: Brands / logos you are not allowed to use.
panic-arret-d-urgence-relache-toutes-les: PANIC = emergency stop: releases every held key or button and cuts the connection. Global shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+Pause.
part-des-etoiles-reversee-au-createur-du: Share of the stars paid to the pack creator. Slide from 0 % (free) to 15 % max. Taken from the broadcaster (the viewer pays the same), shown at install time.
prerequis-10-minecraft-java-1-20-serveur:
# Requirements
- Minecraft Java 1.20+, multiplayer server with RCON enabled

## Cheat codes / commands
```
/give {player} minecraft:diamond 1
/effect give {player} minecraft:speed 30 2
```

Headings (#), lists (-), **bold**, `code`, and code blocks ``` (copyable) are supported.
realiser-l-icone-d-un-cadeau-personnalis: Making the icon for a custom gift
renseigne-les-infos-ajoute-des-interacti: Fill in the info, add interactions, then save it private (just for you) or publish it public (moderated). To edit an existing pack, open it from “My bundles”.
toute-icone-diffusee-aux-spectateurs-pas: Every icon shown to viewers goes through moderation (even in a private pack), because the public sees it.
transforme-les-cadeaux-messages-et-follo: Turn the gifts, messages and follows from your live into real actions.
type-de-changement-pour-la-nouvelle-vers: Type of change for the new version
un-identifiant-court-et-unique-pour-ton-: A short, unique ID for your pack, like a web address (e.g. my-minecraft-pack). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. It shows up in links and CANNOT be changed after creation.
versions-en-attente-d-une-decision-humai: Versions waiting on a human decision. Until a version is approved, its creator cannot publish it and nobody else can install it.
